MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING

This Memorandum of Understanding is made as of May 4, 2026 between Eastgate Neighborhood Association and Calder Community College.

1. Background. The Association and the College have talked for some time about the vacant lot on Fourth Street.

2. Good Faith. The Association and the College will act in good faith toward each other.

3. Publicity. Neither will issue a press release about the lot without telling the other first.

EASTGATE NEIGHBORHOOD ASSOCIATION

By: ______________________
Name: Rosa Whitcomb
Title: President

CALDER COMMUNITY COLLEGE

By: ______________________
Name: Dr. Henry Olsen
Title: Vice President for Administration
